headline: Names a Winston-Salem, North Carolina postal facility the "Maya Angelou Memorial Post Office" in honor of the poet and author.
what_it_does: This law renames a United States Postal Service facility at 200 Town Run Lane in Winston-Salem, North Carolina. The building is now officially called the "Maya Angelou Memorial Post Office." It is a ceremonial designation and does not change how mail is delivered or how the post office operates.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on June 13, 2016.
